meta.note: Browse index only. Heavy per-item fields stay in data/shop-items/; fetch the module named in "src" for full detail.

toad_town_market.name: Toad Town Market
toad_town_market.description: The heart of Mushroom Kingdom commerce. Legitimate goods only.
toad_town_market.warioComment: Bah! Too many rules. But their garlic bread is decent.

rogueport_black_market.name: Rogueport Black Market
rogueport_black_market.description: No receipts. No refunds. No witnesses.
rogueport_black_market.warning: Iron Legion actively monitors this vendor
rogueport_black_market.warioComment: WAH! My kind of place! No taxes, no questions!

gilded_gryphon.name: Gilded Gryphon Armory
gilded_gryphon.warioComment: Too expensive! But Wario respects the hustle.

shamans_hut.name: Shaman's Hut
shamans_hut.warioComment: Smells worse than Wario's gym socks. I love it.

comet_observatory.name: Comet Observatory Gift Shop
comet_observatory.description: Cosmic wonders from beyond the stars.
comet_observatory.warioComment: Overpriced space junk! ...Wario wants everything in it.

valley_trading_post.name: Valley of Bowser Trading Post
valley_trading_post.warioComment: Bowser's rejects are Wario's bargains! WAH HA HA!

rakasha_grounds.name: Rakasha Tribal Grounds
rakasha_grounds.warioComment: Wario once arm-wrestled a Rakasha. Wario won. OBVIOUSLY.

faction_quartermaster.name: Liberated Toads Quartermaster
faction_quartermaster.warioComment: Mushroom people giving discounts? Wario approves!

onyx_hand.name: Onyx Hand Broker
onyx_hand.description: The vampire syndicate deals in favors, not gold.
onyx_hand.warioComment: Even Wario thinks these guys are shady. Wario LOVES it.

wario_land.name: Wario Land Exchange
wario_land.description: Wario's official faction storefront. Wario Coin and Wario Points accepted.
wario_land.warioComment: WARIO LAND! The name is already a guarantee! WAH!

wario_direct.name: Wario Direct Sales
wario_direct.description: WAH! You want it? Wario's got it! Premium quality* goods at Wario-approved prices!
wario_direct.warioComment: THE BEST VENDOR! OBVIOUSLY! WAH HA HA HA!
wario_direct.disclaimer: *Quality not guaranteed. All sales final. Wario is not responsible for explosions, curses, dimensional rifts, or garlic breath.

hole_hawker.name: The Hole Hawker
hole_hawker.description: Sells things that fell through the cracks of reality.
hole_hawker.warioComment: This guy creeps Wario out. But his prices are... acceptable.

garlic_guild.name: Wario's Garlic Guild
garlic_guild.description: The finest garlic products in ALL dimensions. Founded, owned, and operated by the great WARIO himself!
garlic_guild.warioComment: PERFECTION! Just like Wario! Buy garlic or GET OUT!
